scope: Refresh current open-source DWG/DXF issue status and exact optional comparator provenance; reconcile peer failure patterns with existing local fast-test evidence without duplicating work or promoting support claims.

method.kind: Read-only source review of GitHub issue bodies, ACadSharp issue inventory, official PyPI artifact metadata, current local source, plan entries, and prior local test receipts
localInspection: dwgBuffer::getCmColor distinguishes R2004+ CMC method 0xC2 RGB from method 0xC3 indexed ACI; existing generated CMC vectors cover ACI 104/255 and zero-blue RGB.
Existing plan receipts cover a generated AC1024/AC1032 DWG LAYER CMC-to-ASCII/binary-DXF path and group 62/420 fallback policy; no tests were rerun in this research pass.
Existing local progress entry covers ASCII refusal and binary framing/alignment for generated CR/LF/CRLF strings, plus destination preservation.
Existing block-owner tests and plan receipts cover consecutive named block ownership and per-owner child inventories; this review adds no test.
Existing PAR-49/7G.3 plan entries distinguish unresolved-child traversal from successful complete conversion and retain per-owner identity requirements.
method.evidenceRule: Peer issue status and author measurements describe specific routes and revisions. A GitHub issue left open may contain a later master-verification comment. Peer results are not local reproductions, format authority, or semantic support evidence. Package hashes pin only the named artifact, not the runtime or dependency environment.

evidence.topic: R2004+ CMC color method and peer-proposal correction
evidence.observed: The issue remains open. Its author corrected an initial guard after measuring that the separately read R2004+ BS index is vestigial; method 0xC3 carries an ACI in the packed word's low byte, whereas 0xC2 is RGB and must not be treated as an ACI. The report includes palette-collision and low-byte fallback symptoms.
doesNotEstablish: a new local defect or a current LibreDWG release result
that palette reverse lookup is valid for explicit ACI source values
a universal nearest-ACI metric or native CAD display behavior
evidence.planUse: Reuse existing ODA-shaped CMC controls and generated AC1024/AC1032 LAYER-to-DXF tests. Do not add duplicate cases or copy the superseded guard. Preserve the distinction between source ACI, truecolor, and compatibility group-62 fallback.

evidence.topic: Peer output-survival reports and already-existing local gates
evidence.observed: #1408 reports CR-induced ASCII physical-line corruption in a complex TEXT/MTEXT value and lacks a reduced reproducer. #1409 attributes empty later block bodies to a mutable index passed from a block-header loop into a child writer. Both remain peer-specific reports.
doesNotEstablish: that ASCII refusal is equivalent to preserving peer text semantics
that total entity counts alone prove block ownership parity
evidence.planUse: Reuse existing local generated control-character framing and destination-preservation checks, and existing ASCII/binary per-owner block census tests. Add no duplicate test.

evidence.topic: Open issue page versus master-verified regression status
evidence.observed: GitHub still displays #1357 as open, while its author reports that master restored expected counts on three AC1021 drawings and notes intervening R2007 decode fixes as a likely cause.
doesNotEstablish: an immutable fix revision or a release containing the change
identity/owner/payload parity from aggregate count equality
that local unresolved-child hardening is unnecessary
evidence.planUse: Classify as a historical/master-verified peer regression pattern, not a currently confirmed peer failure. Retain local per-owner identity and explicit partial/failure disposition gates.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp current hostile-input and performance reports
evidence.observed: The current issue list continues to show recursive DXF advancement/stack exhaustion, per-application XDATA size overflow, and recursive deep-copy work for nested blocks as distinct reports.
doesNotEstablish: the same algorithms or thresholds in libdxfrw
a normative DXF/DWG field limit from a peer-reported threshold
that one resource metric can substitute for another
evidence.planUse: Keep existing parser recursion/work, encoded-size, graph traversal, allocation and progress owners separate; use small generated boundaries and sentinel checks in touched fast targets, with crash/sanitizer/fuzz checks at scheduled composed gates.

evidence.observed: PyPI records ezdxf 1.4.5 released 2026-10-16. The universal wheel SHA-256 is 70a79ec7d40990f60453e3c87ffe9f668907ee061cf6f4c0a3794d032ec2b40e; the source archive SHA-256 is a6c3bbc1a65ce764d97c5beafe6ae693d8ed14c6cdae366b50e1974a79d4a00a.
doesNotEstablish: Python runtime or transitive dependency identity
whether optional C extensions are present or loaded
evidence.planUse: If ezdxf is used at the already-planned optional composed comparison, bind the selected artifact hash, Python implementation/version, locked transitive dependency hashes, platform and extension status. Do not install it as a routine fast-test dependency.
